name: Benson, Close et al. 2025 marine LBG data and code archive
kind: deposited analysis archive (PBDB download, code, GCM fields)
potential_eprp_use: Q-027 joint support for latitudinal-gradient estimation outside Europe/North America; candidate inputs for Q-040
verified_evidence: Zenodo API metadata read; zip central directory listed by HTTP range requests; 4 members extracted with CRC check (non-chordate animal PBDB download of 2022-05-23, 712,947 rows; region, country-code and interval tables); per-stage support screen built (data/q027-joint-support). Processed outputs absent; companion Dryad 10.5061/dryad.6djh9w1bx supplied locally by Barry on 11 October. Independent audit (data/q027-support-audit) reproduces 27/95 presence screen; source age-rule sensitivity gives 46/99. Neither establishes usable richness or power
licence_access_note: CC BY 4.0 (Zenodo); PBDB CC BY 4.0; Dryad companion CC0; locally supplied
next_audit_question: Which stages/cells meet the intended estimator under declared age assignment, whole-cell region treatment, richness eligibility and climate support, before designing power?
